0.original: Uin Nee wishes to experience the joys of boating in a Fuath-free environment.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Survey the designated location east of Mithai Glorianda and obtain a wing membrane from a deepglider.

25.original: Deliver the deepglider wing membrane to Uin Nee.

48.original: Tyr Beq was telling me all about your trip to Kholusia. Is it true that the ocean is even bigger than Longmirror Lake? I hear the mortals there love to go boating, where they can forget their troubles and maybe catch a fish or two.

49.original: I'd love to try it here, but those horrid Fuath are bound to show up and spoil our fun! <hex:02100103>...Oh, of course! We can do it in Lyhe Mheg instead, and have the children join us too!

50.original: There's just one problem: I haven't the faintest idea what a boat looks like. Perhaps we can try making one from the wing of a deepglider...which I'm sure you'll be more than willing to collect for me!

51.original: I have a vague recollection of asking you to bring me something... What was it?

52.original: Ah, yes! I remember now! This should work nicely. Not that I have a clue what to do with it...

53.original: So it needs to float on the water and support the weight of several small children. It can't be that difficult to make a thing like that from a bit of lizard skin, can it?

54.original: And since we won't be boating on real water, as long as we can conjure up something that at least <hex:021A020203>looks<hex:021A020103> like a boat, it should be fine. Oh yes, we'll have the finest adventures with the children on the ocean blue! ...It <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> blue, isn't it?
